reason:
The artifact contains only kernel.py, meta.json and problem.txt — there is no test.py or get_inputs narrowing the input domain — so problem.txt is the operative contract. It explicitly states the kernel must dequantize every column with the scale/zero of the group it actually belongs to "for any K -- including a K that is not an exact multiple of group_size", with scales/zeros supplied as ceil(K/group_size) rows. Two confirmed in_scope claims show the kernel does not implement that required behavior:

c1 (decisive): the host wrapper computes num_groups = K // group_size (floor) and clamps g_idx to num_groups-1 (kernel.py:69-73). Probe t9 at K=48, group_size=32, bits=4 — chosen with K divisible by BLOCK_SIZE_K=16 so the c2 tail defect cannot confound — showed the kernel output matched the wrong "all columns -> group 0" floor model to 3.6e-07 while differing from the contract reference by 55.54 max abs (99.1% relative to a 56.06 max reference magnitude). The trailing short group's supplied scales/zeros row is never read. This is exactly the clause the contract singles out, not a tolerance, layout, or reduction-order artifact.

c2 (decisive, independent): the reduction loop runs cdiv(K, BLOCK_SIZE_K) iterations with no offs_k < K mask on a, b, or g_idx (kernel.py:41-54). Probe t10 at K=40 with group_size=40 (ceil==floor==1, so the c1 mapping defect is inactive) showed all 1024 output elements wrong, max abs err 28.70 against a reference whose own max magnitude is 7.18. The tail contributes garbage rather than zero, and it also reads past the end of the length-K g_idx table. K=40 is a contract-admitted K.

Neither deviation is excused by any contract clause: the reference is finite and well-defined in both cases, there is no tie-breaking or precision allowance at play, and the control probe t15 confirms the base path is accurate to ~1e-5 on aligned configurations, so the errors are genuine logic defects on the exact ragged-K path the contract calls out.

c3 (K < group_size producing g_idx = -1 and an out-of-bounds read of the row preceding scales/zeros) is confirmed as a mechanism but carries scope "unknown"; I set it aside as a corroborating note only and it is not needed for this verdict.
